_readme: Work packages. INDICATIVE placeholder structure based on a typical Erasmus+ CBHE project. Replace titles, objectives, activities, leads and deliverables with the official content from Annex I (Description of the Action) of the Grant Agreement.

workPackages.title: Project Management and Coordination
objectives: Ensure effective coordination, communication and decision-making across the consortium
Monitor progress, risks and budget against the work plan
outcomes: Efficient and timely implementation of the project

workPackages.title: Needs Analysis and State of the Art
objectives: Analyse current computing curricula and institutional practice
Identify skills gaps in green, ethical and sustainable computing
activities: Survey of partner institutions and stakeholders
Review of good practice in Europe and partner countries

workPackages.title: Curriculum Development and Modernisation
objectives: Design new or updated modules on green, ethical and sustainable computing
Develop open teaching and learning materials

workPackages.title: Capacity Building and Pilot Implementation
objectives: Pilot the new modules with students
activities: Pilot delivery and student feedback collection

workPackages.title: Quality Assurance and Evaluation
objectives: Ensure the quality of project processes and results

workPackages.title: Dissemination, Exploitation and Sustainability
objectives: Communicate project results to target groups
Ensure the long-term use of results beyond the funding period
outcomes: Wide visibility and lasting impact of project results
